# agg_haus_facts

`data-warehouse-359101.analytics.agg_haus_facts` · dbt area: `growth`

Conversions for Haus, our incrementality testing partner. These fields are defined in their help docs at support.haus.io/ Sourced from Hubspot and the Portal database.

| Column | Description |
|---|---|
| `country` | The country for the given region. |
| `kpi_name` | The name of your business KPI. |
| `region` | The code associated with the region. This should be a postalcode, state code, or DMA code. |
| `region_type` | Geographic granularity of the data. This can be postal code, Designated Market Area (DMA), U.S. state. |
| `time` | Date on which the transaction occurred |
| `value` | Value of the KPI in the specified region and time. |
